heading.title: Information to the Police and their Powers to Investigate

article.title: Report of investigation by subordinate police officer
article.content:
188Report of investigation by subordinate police officer

Section 188 · Chapter XIII
When any subordinate police officer has made any investigation under this Chapter, he shall report the result of such investigation to the officer in charge of the police station.
